treatment_path.sample_assignment: Selected PDE records are assigned to Part D sponsors by contract in the HPMS Part D IPM Module.
required_evidence: prescription record hardcopy or LTC medication order
treatment_path.record_alignment: Supporting documentation must correspond to the sampled reconciliation PDE and date of service; later adjustments do not replace the June 29, 2023 reconciliation target.
treatment_path.missing_documentation: A Missing Documentation Form records unsuccessful retrieval attempts but does not substitute for valid evidence; the PDE remains fail.
treatment_path.cure_window: A completed or failed PDE can receive new documentation only through an approved reset or resubmission window before the final deadline.
treatment_path.final_review: All files submitted by the final deadline, including incomplete files, undergo Part D IPM review.
treatment_path.successor_responsibility: A gaining sponsor remains responsible for predecessor-contract records and the federal ten-year retention requirement is not displaced by shorter state rules.

published_measurement_effect.classification_scope: statistical overpayment measurement after the documentation submission and review process

methodology_closure_decision.closure_scope: Close only the FY2024-reporting/CY2022 sponsor-documentation dependency treatment field.

evidence_boundaries: A failed PDE is a review status and does not by itself prove that the transaction was monetarily wrong.
The 2.70 percent documentation component is a statistical measurement category, not a transaction-level debt ledger.
Outside-agency-control is publisher taxonomy, not a legal nonrecoverability finding.
No source links the full statistical estimate to identified debt, appeal outcomes, collectibility, cash collection, recovery, fraud, waste, or savings.
